entities.summary: Volovets is a rural settlement in Mukachevo Raion, Zakarpattia Oblast, western Ukraine. Volovets was the administrative center of Volovets Raion (district) until 2020, housing the district's local administration buildings. The town's population was 5,178 as of the 2001 Ukrainian Census. Current population: 4,961.
